description: This file defines a class 'AesGcmDecryptingStream' which provides functionality to handle streams of data encrypted using AES GCM mode, including decryption capabilities.

classes.name: AesGcmDecryptingStream
classes.description: A class that implements a stream for AES GCM decryption, conforming to the AesStreamInterface, allowing decryption of data streams encrypted with AES GCM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the decryption stream with ciphertext, key, IV, tag, and optional AAD, tag length, and key size.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns the OpenSSL cipher method name based on key size.

methods.name: getAesName
methods.description: Returns the AES cipher mode name.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Returns the initialization vector in use.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates and returns a decrypted stream, handling different PHP versions.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates whether the stream is writable; returns false for this decrypting stream.
